<<<POU name=TankLevel kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK TankLevel
VAR_INPUT
    level : REAL;
    lowLevel : REAL;
    highLevel : REAL;
    highHighLevel : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    pumpOn : BOOL;
    highHighAlarm : BOOL;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
IF level < lowLevel THEN
    pumpOn := TRUE;
ELSIF level > highLevel THEN
    pumpOn := FALSE;
END_IF
highHighAlarm := (level > highHighLevel);
<<<END>>>
